title: South Florida Going Out Guide, Cheapest First
igCaption:
Free RSVP, $28 train fares, $31.90 comedy, and a new disco bar.
Nov. 6 to 12, South Florida, free to $31.90

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Looking for plans this week? Start with free, then twenty-eight dollars, then late-night disco in Fort Lauderdale.

The cheapest move is a free RSVP. The North Miami Greek Festival runs Friday, November sixth, at the Greek Orthodox Church of the Annunciation, with live music, traditional dancing, homemade meals, vendors, raffles, and guided church tours.

scenes.text: For a cheap getaway, Amtrak has one-way Coach fares from Miami to Orlando and Miami to Tampa as low as twenty-eight dollars. Book by November twelfth for travel from December first through March fourteenth.
scenes.caption: For a cheap getaway, Amtrak has one-way Coach fares from Miami to Orlando and Miami to Tampa as low as $28. Book by Nov. 12 for travel from Dec. 1 through March 14.

scenes.text: Sunday comedy is Rocky Dale Davis at the Fort Lauderdale Improv in Dania Beach. The show starts at six p.m. Tickets cost thirty-one dollars and ninety cents. His videos have topped five hundred million views. If you’re there, open NEAR and see who else caught the set.

scenes.text: Late-night goes to Good Night John Boy at 270 SE Sixth Avenue in Fort Lauderdale. It opened Friday, November sixth, with 1970s decor, nightly DJs, dancing, and Disco Punch served in a take-home disco cup.

scenes.text: Which one are you doing, and what should we cover next? That same night-out haze is why NEAR matters, turning the faces you passed in line or on the dance floor into names you actually know.
